---

# INCIDENT RESPONSE REPORT

## VICTIM SYSTEM IDENTIFICATION

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| IPv4 Address | 10.1.21.58 |
| MAC Address | 00:21:5d:c8:0e:f2 |
| Windows Hostname | DESKTOP-ES9F3ML |

| Operating System | Windows 10/11 (NT 10.0) |

---

## MALWARE CLASSIFICATION

**Family:** Browser Fingerprinting Info-Stealer (behavioral classification - signature confidence: High)

**Behavioral Indicators:**
- Injected into Chrome and Edge browsers
- Collects extensive device/system fingerprinting data (canvas fingerprints, WebGL details, fonts, hardware specs, audio, screen resolution)
- Exfiltrates fingerprinting data via HTTP POST requests to command-and-control server
- Unique agent ID and token-based tracking mechanism
- Communicates with multiple C&C domains using form-encoded POST requests to `/api/set_agent` endpoint

---

## INDICATORS OF COMPROMISE

### Command-and-Control Endpoints

| Domain | IP Address | Port | Purpose | Data Volume |
|--------|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| whitepepper.su | 153.92.1.49 | 80, 443 | Primary C&C - fingerprinting exfiltration | HTTP POST |
| arch.filemegahab4.sbs | 104.21.46.67 | 443 | Secondary C&C | ~16 MB transferred |
| media.megafilehub4.lat | 104.21.48.156 | 443 | Secondary C&C | Multiple TLS connections |
| communicationfirewall-security.cc | 104.21.9.36 | 443 | Secondary C&C | Multiple TLS connections |
| holiday-forever.cc | 80.97.160.24 | 443 | Secondary C&C | Multiple TLS connections |
| whooptm.cyou | 62.72.32.156 | 443 | Secondary C&C | Multiple TLS connections |
| hiyter.com | 104.21.22.231 | 443 | Secondary C&C | Multiple TLS connections |

### Malicious URLs

- `http://whitepepper.su/api/set_agent?id=3BF67EC05320C5729578BE4C0ADF174C&token=842e2802df0f0a06b4ed51f12f4387e761523b&description=&agent=Chrome`
- `http://whitepepper.su/api/set_agent?id=3BF67EC05320C5729578BE4C0ADF174C&token=842e2802df0f0a06b4ed51f12f4387e761523b&description=&agent=Chrome&act=log` (POST)
- `http://whitepepper.su/api/set_agent?id=3BF67EC05320C5729578BE4C0ADF174C&token=842e2802df0f0a06b4ed51f12f4387e761523b&description=&agent=Edge&act=log` (POST)

### Unique Identifiers

| Identifier | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Agent ID | 3BF67EC05320C5729578BE4C0ADF174C |
| Agent Token | 842e2802df0f0a06b4ed51f12f4387e761523b |

### File Hashes

Unable to extract SHA256 hashes: large data transfers (16 MB to arch.filemegahab4.sbs) are encrypted over TLS/HTTPS. Payloads not recoverable from encrypted traffic capture.

---

## EXFILTRATED DATA

The POST requests to `whitepepper.su` contain the following browser and system fingerprinting data:

- Timestamp of collection
- Browser user-agent (Chrome 144.0.0.0, Edge 144.0.0.0)
- Platform (Windows NT 10.0, 64-bit)
- Screen resolution (1920x1080)
- Canvas fingerprint (base64-encoded PNG data)
- WebGL vendor/renderer (ANGLE, AMD Radeon R9 200 Series)
- Installed fonts (Arial, Georgia, Courier, Verdana, etc.)
- Hardware concurrency (12 cores)
- Audio sample rate (48000 Hz)
- Network connection type (4G effective type)
- Language/localization settings (en-US)
- Browser plugin list
- Cookie and PDF viewer status

---

## ATTACK VECTOR & TIMELINE

**Start Time:** 2026-01-27T23:05:40 UTC (first POST to whitepepper.su observed)  
**Capture Period:** 2026-01-28 (multi-day capture)  
**Vector:** Browser injection/plugin compromise - malware runs within browser context

The malware systematically reports browser fingerprints to track the victim's browser behavior and system configuration over time, characteristic of reconnaissance or credential harvesting campaigns.
